sub: We're a UC student-owned crew. We drive to your house or job on the west side and detail your car right there. Full Interiors from {price:full-interior}.

hero.alt: A third-row seat after stain treatment
hero.caption: A recent stain treatment on the west side

localParagraph:
Delhi runs downhill from Delhi Road to the Ohio River, and Price Hill sits on the hill above it. That's a lot of in and out of the car: Glenway Avenue, Rapid Run Road, Anderson Ferry, and River Road, where U.S. 50 carries heavy truck traffic along the water. Most of what we clean out here is the inside: mats, carpet, car seats, dog hair and whatever has collected under the front seats.

You don't drive anywhere. Book online, see the full price with travel and tax before you confirm, and we show up at your driveway in Delhi Hills or Delshire, your street in West Price Hill, or your work parking lot. You get on with your day, and you pay when it's done.

faq.q: Do you come down to River Road and Sayler Park?
faq.a: Yes. Anywhere in Delhi Township and Price Hill, river side included. We just need room to park next to your car and walk around it.

faq.q: Can you do my car while I'm at work?
faq.a: Yes, if your lot allows it. A lot of our customers book us at work. Add a note about where the car is parked when you book.

faq.q: How much is travel to Delhi or Price Hill?
faq.a: It's based on the drive to your address and it's in your total, with tax, before you book. Nothing gets added after.
